verdict.rationale: Twenty ships AI features, so a control that keeps customer data out of AI model training is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions model training, a training opt-out, or any policy on AI data use. Self-hosting to 'own your data end to end' and role-based limits on what AI agents can see are related controls, but neither prevents data from being used to train models, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
